feeds.title: SoSco Duo Blog
feeds.description: Read stories of real wedding ceremonies & events played by some of the best musicians in Arizona. SoSco Duo is the premier flute and guitar duo in Arizona. Our award-winning duo has been providing top-notch musical entertainment for high-end weddings, private parties, and corporate events since 2014.

feeds.title: Phoenix New Times » Music
feeds.description: Stay current on local musicians, performances and venues at Phoenix New Times, your guide to the Phoenix music scene. Since its founding in 1970, Phoenix New Times has become a cultural force in the Valley of the Sun.

feeds.title: Beneath a Desert Sky
feeds.description: Beneath a Desert Sky is your connection to Phoenix area concert photographs and reviews and concert announcements. This live music blog is dedicated to rock music and photographers that enjoy capturing it in still images. We expect to cover rock in all (or at least most) of its incarnations - hard rock, alt rock, classic rock, punk, indie, metal, thrash, folk. Some of the music we cover may even cross over into other genres.

feeds.title: PHOENIX Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Our expository features, narratives, profiles, and investigative features keep our 385,000 readers in touch with the Valley's latest trends, events, personalities and places. Stay up to date with music events happening in Phoenix city, concerts and more!

feeds.title: Phoenix Conservatory Of Music Blog
feeds.description: PCM was founded in 1998 & provides a continuum of high-quality music education and experiences to nearly 2,000 students annually. Programs range from introductory level in-house education and after-school programs, to more advanced private lessons. Get the latest news and updates from the academy, events, announcements and more!

feeds.title: Phoenix Bangerz
feeds.description: Phoenix Bangerz is #1 Arizona based music blog at covering what's REALLY bangin! We are given the mission of empowering local artists & events while still covering mainstream news and bringing America 1 step closer to the you.

feeds.title: Vanyaland » Phoenix Music News
feeds.description: Covering music, film, TV, and comedy since 2013, Vanyaland is an online magazine for 'culture-forward' individuals looking to discover a definitive news, lifestyle, and entertainment source in their city and beyond. Follow the upcoming music, albums, singles and artists' news.

feeds.title: LJE-OLATUNDE
feeds.description: LJE-Olatunde, also known as Long Journey Entertainment LLC, is a Phoenix-based entertainment company founded by Diarra 'Olatunde' Hamilton. The site showcases Olatunde's work as a multi-talented artist and producer, emphasizing his contributions to music, film, and community outreach. It highlights his hip-hop roots, notable collaborations, and influence in the medical/recreational industry. The company offers services in film production, photography, event organization, and creative scripting, aiming to empower passionate individuals and foster creative collaborations.
